title: Standing tackle has animation thresholds
summary: EA's gameplay deep dive describes basic animations below 71 standing tackle and access to all standing-tackle animations at 85 or above. An animation unlock does not establish that further attribute upgrades have no effect on tackle outcomes.

title: Positioning can still be an unlock requirement
summary: The source describes attack positioning as affecting AI-controlled positioning. Deprioritising that use is reasonable for this setup, but the attribute can still unlock a specialization: the Magician's Invader requires 90. Do not describe it as universally worthless.

title: Reactions and finishing: no verified formula here
summary: Players discuss whether reactions contributes to finishing and other on-ball actions. The discussion includes a claimed finesse-shot weighting, but this library has not verified its original source or reproduced a controlled FC 26 Clubs test. Do not use a numeric finishing multiplier or a claimed optimal reactions ceiling.

title: Body and facility effects are separate from AP upgrades
summary: EA describes height and weight as changing some match attributes without changing the archetype's base values. This calculator keeps bought attributes and projected match values separate. Its numerical modifiers and facility costs come from the community builder.

title: Running animation is not an AcceleRATE category
summary: Mufasa provides 23 named animation clips. Compare the original clips for appearance. This library has no verified real-player mapping, speed advantage or hidden animation modifier for these names; the adviser must label any suggested resemblance as tentative.

title: The published data and current calculator disagree on one slot
summary: The machine-readable JSON lists the third regular PlayStyle slot at level 20, while the current calculator logic uses level 30. Build Lab uses 30 and records the discrepancy. The reference contains 11 outfield archetypes; goalkeeper builds are not included.
